chose: RUSTSEC-2026-0459 (the SQLite that sqlx 0.8.6 bundles) is cleared by a dated, reasoned ignore in deny.toml, revisited by 2027-02-11 and resting on a written invariant that every SQLite file opened here is one this deployment wrote, not by a sqlx bump.
options: a dated, reasoned ignore in deny.toml, backed by a written invariant
gray: No sqlx release reaches the fixed libsqlite3-sys 0.39: every sqlx-sqlite 0.8.x pins ^0.30.1, and 0.9.0 caps below 0.38, so the bump would not clear it. The flaw needs a database and -wal pair a less-trusted party wrote, and nothing here opens one; whether that is enough to ignore an advisory no convention says.
undo: Drop the RUSTSEC-2026-0459 entry from deny.toml once a sqlx-sqlite release accepts libsqlite3-sys >= 0.39, then bump sqlx.
